I have been farming here in Amhara for many years, and I know maize grows much better with fertilizer, so I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative to put on this plot, though I cannot afford the full recommended amount. I will also plant improved maize seed because I have seen it gives a better yield when used together with fertilizer. My family and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves on this small plot, as we do not have extra money to pay for hired labor. We rely on the rains and do not have access to irrigation, and I do not see the need for chemicals to control pests on maize.
